items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: He had come back. When I came back in the band he had come back.

ctx.x: Blood, Sweat and Tears sound. So they also, if you consider them a Pop group, because they were very successful. I came in at the very tail end of the success you know. I was on salary. I didn’t share in any of the revenues, shall we say, in the band.
David Clayton Thomas was gone at that time, wasn’t he?
He had come back. When I came back in the band he had come back. He was a great singer for that type of stuff.
